tokens.name: green-500
tokens.usage: Singology Green, taken exactly from the choir site's section grounds. The brand's signature field colour: panels, the primary button, the progress fill. A fill only — white text on it is 1.8:1, so text on it is always `ink-on-brand`.

tokens.name: green-300
tokens.usage: The site's nav pill (Singology Green at 72% over white). Navigation bar ground only; text on it is always `ink-on-brand` (6.2:1 light and dark).

tokens.name: green-700
tokens.usage: Deep green for green *text* on light grounds (5.4:1 on white). Never a large fill — it is a working colour, not the brand face.

tokens.name: navy-700
tokens.usage: Stage Navy, exact from the site's slide panels. Feature panels, the progress track, headings in the light theme. Text on it is `ink-on-stage`.

tokens.name: navy-600
tokens.usage: Slate, the site's alternate slide panel. Second stage colour where two dark panels sit side by side; never next to `navy-700` as the only distinction between states.

tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Deepest navy (an addition, not on the site): the dark-theme page ground and `focus-on-brand`.

tokens.name: olive-500
tokens.usage: Tutor Olive, exact from the site's 'Meet the tutors' heading and About pills. Decorative fills only (cover shapes, illustration). The site sets it as a heading on `lime-100`, but that pair is 1.8:1 — use `accent-olive` for olive headings. For light-theme button fills use `olive-700` (white on olive-500 is 2.2:1).

tokens.name: olive-700
tokens.usage: Deep olive (an addition): coach-related buttons and olive text on white or `lime-100` in the light theme (5.6:1 on white).

tokens.name: lime-100
tokens.usage: Tutor Lime, the ground of the site's tutors page (sampled from the rendered page). Coach profile areas and soft tinted panels.

tokens.name: charcoal-700
tokens.usage: The site's body text colour, exact. Light-theme body copy via `ink`.

tokens.name: grey-600
tokens.usage: The site's secondary nav text, exact. Light-theme metadata via `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: paper-100
tokens.usage: The site's header bar grey, exact. Light-theme alternate surface.

tokens.name: paper-0
tokens.usage: White. Light-theme page ground and `ink-on-stage`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Header bars, table stripes, empty portrait discs, quiet grouped areas.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards (session cards, forms) — in the light theme separated from `surface` by `line`, in the dark theme by tone.

tokens.name: surface-stage
tokens.usage: Feature panels (`.sg-panel`), date tiles. Pair with `ink-on-stage`; wrap content in `.sg-stage` so components switch automatically.

tokens.name: surface-brand
tokens.usage: Brand panels (`.sg-panel--brand`). Pair with `ink-on-brand`; wrap content in `.sg-brand`.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Coach areas and confirmed-status tags (`.sg-panel--tint`, `.sg-tag--confirmed`). Text on it is `ink` / `ink-strong` / `accent-olive`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card edges only — too faint for control borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders (3:1+ on `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy on `surface`, `surface-alt`, `surface-raised` and `surface-tint`.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Headings, labels, active nav text, secondary-button text and border, on every surface but stage and brand.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, helper text, timestamps on `surface`, `surface-alt` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-on-stage
tokens.usage: All text on `surface-stage` (11:1).

tokens.name: ink-on-stage-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `surface-stage` (7:1).

tokens.name: ink-on-brand
tokens.usage: All text and icons on `surface-brand` and `green-300` (6.2:1). Never white.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and green emphasis text on `surface`, `surface-alt` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: accent-olive
tokens.usage: Olive text (coach names, 'confirmed' tags) on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-tint`.

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill — the one thing each screen is for (Book, Join session). Label in `on-action-primary`.

tokens.name: action-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover/pressed fill.

tokens.name: on-action-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button label (6.2:1 on `action-primary`).

tokens.name: action-coach
tokens.usage: Coach-related buttons (View profile, Message coach) — the site's olive About pill, darkened for legibility.

tokens.name: on-action-coach
tokens.usage: Label on `action-coach`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring (2px solid, 2px offset) on `surface`, `surface-alt`, `surface-raised`, `surface-tint`.

tokens.name: focus-on-stage
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside `.sg-stage` (6.2:1 on navy).

tokens.name: focus-on-brand
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside `.sg-brand` (8.8:1 on green).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, invalid input borders, cancelled tags — always with a word ('Error:', 'Cancelled'). On `surface`, `surface-raised`, `danger-soft`.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error banner and cancelled-tag ground.

families.sans: Jost, "Futura PT", Futura, "Avenir Next", Avenir, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page at most: welcome screens, panel heroes. Echoes the site's heavy Avenir hero lines. Sentence case.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Wide-tracked caps above a heading — the site's Lulo 'MEET THE TUTORS' line. Always uppercase (`.sg-eyebrow` sets it); 2–4 words.

styles.name: voice
styles.sample: Get to know the coach who'll be in your corner every week.
styles.usage: The warm aside under a heading, and coach names — the site's Didot italic. Always italic; one or two sentences, never body copy.

styles.name: voice-small
styles.usage: Coach names on cards, pull-quotes from coach feedback.

styles.name: body-large
styles.sample: Our coaches will help you build confidence, one song at a time.
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs and panel copy — the site's Avenir Light hero text.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Warm up for five minutes before your session starts.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons and nav — the site's Futura Book caps. Uppercase is applied by `.sg-btn` / `.sg-nav`; field labels use it in sentence case.
